==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I quickly met a scientist named Puck Man. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Puck Man resembles an obese, bald, brown skinned elf with pointed ears who wears a white suit with a red tie and a yellow undershirt.) Puck Man has created special pucks across the village that let him bring inanimate objects to life. (Life Pucks resemble silver metal hockey puck shaped devices that have a silver metal stake in the back that lets them be inserted into the ground. They have a round and circular neon dark blue holographic screen on the top of the device.) He tried to use his pucks to turn my own Lucid Lord power against me, but I was able to defeat him by using the Reality Warping Stone. (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.) (Lucid Light Man resembles glowing bald faceless humanoid made of sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars. Lucid Light Man is my Lucid Light brought to life by the Puck Man.) (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
